page_note: 该页为《Industry outlook 2025》零售章节，含一段正文、一个左侧标题栏的分组柱状图（2024 与 2025 各地区零售销量增速）以及下方小标题与两栏正文。

heading.title: Asia will lead global retail sales growth, and South America will rebound in 2025

components.evidence: two bars per region slot, dark blue "2024" beside red "2025" at USMCA, Europe, etc.
South America 2024 bar drops below the zero baseline toward the −8 tick
a heavy black horizontal rule at the 0 level runs across the plot, bars hang below it
the only value ticks "4, 2, 0, −2, −4, −6, −8" sit on the right edge
thin grey horizontal rules at 4, 2, −2, −4, −6, −8; no vertical rules
"2024" and "2025" swatches stacked in the left column, level with the plot
"Source: EIU." and "Copyright © The Economist Intelligence Unit 2024. All rights reserved." in small print
"Retail sales volume growth rate, %" under the title; axis shows bare numbers only

new_components.name: left_metadata_column
new_components.evidence: title, unit line, legend and source all stacked in a narrow left column beside the plot
new_components.why_it_matters: 标题、单位、图例、来源都不在绘图区上方，解析成表格时容易与图分离，读值时需从左栏取回“%”与年份系列名。

new_components.name: category_labels_below_lowest_tick
new_components.evidence: "USMCA ... MEA" printed under the −8 gridline, far from the zero baseline the bars sit on
new_components.why_it_matters: 类别名与柱底不对齐（负值柱穿过标签区），把标签配到正确柱子需要额外的水平位置判断。

spot_checks.mark: the USMCA 2024 bar (dark blue, small positive)
the Europe 2024 bar, reaching just above the 2 gridline
the Europe 2025 bar (red, below the 2 gridline)
the Asia-Pacific 2024 bar, tallest positive blue bar
the Asia-Pacific 2025 bar, tallest positive red bar
the South America 2024 bar, running down past −6 toward −8
the South America 2025 bar, short red bar just above zero

difficulty_notes: 图上没有任何数值标签，网格线间距为 2 个百分点，而待评的多数值在 0.5–2.6 之间；按 5% 容差，0.5 只允许 ±0.025、0.8 只允许 ±0.04，相当于在 2 个百分点宽的网格间隔里辨认约 1/80 的高度，像素上不可能达到。相比之下标签只需“地区+年份”两个键（USMCA/Europe/Asia-Pacific/South America/MEA × 2024/2025），表格容易承载；标题虽在左栏但可作粗体行导出。因此读值是真正的瓶颈。

suggestions.what_to_add: negative_values 与 reference_line（零线两侧柱子）
suggestions.where_to_change: 样式条件行中加入“含负值且零线加粗、类别标签置于最低刻度下方”的组合
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 负值柱 + 零线位置：对比零线在中部与在底部时的读值误差

suggestions.where_to_change: 图表样式字段 axis_side，允许值轴单独绘在右缘
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 值轴左置 vs 右置对刻度—柱对应关系判定的影响

suggestions.what_to_add: 标题拆分为 number/title/unit_text 与 placement=beside（含 legend_beside_plot、left_metadata_column）
suggestions.where_to_change: 记录字段 heading（title、unit_text、placement）与图例位置字段
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 标题+单位+图例位于左侧栏 vs 位于绘图区上方时，导出表格能否恢复单位“%”

suggestions.what_to_add: 无数值标签时的可达精度（value_label 缺失下的 P1 处理）
suggestions.where_to_change: 评测条件行：values_printed=none 且网格间距为 2 单位时的容差定义
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 按刻度间距归一化的每标记可达精度，替代 5% 相对容差的布尔判定
